description: This walk takes you along the Northumberland coast from the village of Cresswell to the nearby settlements of Amble and Warkworth. The walk passes the lovely Druridge Bay Country Park where you can enjoy a walk around Ladyburn Lake. Along the way there's lovely beaches, sand dunes, wildlife rich nature reserves and some wonderful views out to Coquet Island. The route runs for a distance of about 10 miles along flat coastal paths.
